2. Reason: The Planner contains a critical error in date standardization. It incorrectly interprets "11 September 1962" as "11/09/1962" in MM/DD format, which corresponds to November 9, 1962. In reality, the MM/DD format for September 11 is 09/11. By stating the date is November 9 and instructing to standardize to "11/09/1962" (implying Nov 9) while claiming it matches the September date, the Planner creates a factual contradiction and risks returning an incorrect birth date (Nov 9 instead of Sep 11).
